frontmatter.name: ext-architect
frontmatter.description: Arquitecto de la extensión gas-tools (Chrome MV3 para el editor de Google Apps Script). Úsalo PRIMERO al iniciar cualquier funcionalidad para decidir en qué capa vive (popup, background, content script, MAIN world, Side Panel), qué contratos de mensajes/eventos necesita y qué riesgos tiene. Solo lectura; entrega un plan de diseño.

frontmatter.name: ext-sec
frontmatter.description: Auditor de seguridad de gas-tools (Chrome MV3 + editor de Google Apps Script + IA). Úsalo para auditar manifest, permisos opcionales, manejo de secretos, puentes CustomEvent/chrome.runtime, render de contenido de IA y llamadas a APIs externas. Solo lectura; entrega un informe priorizado.

frontmatter.name: ext-fullstack
frontmatter.description: Desarrollador de gas-tools (extensión Chrome MV3 para el editor de Google Apps Script) en JavaScript sin build step, Web Components con Shadow DOM y APIs chrome.*. Úsalo para implementar el diseño de ext-architect respetando contratos, i18n EN/ES y las convenciones de AGENTS.md.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob

nodes.label: Resumable push/pull transfers with progress panel
nodes.norm_label: resumable push/pull transfers with progress panel
nodes.rationale: Retry resumes from completed files to avoid wasting quota and hitting GitHub secondary rate limits twice; close disabled and beforeunload warning during sync.

nodes.label: Component quality rules (open/close/toggle API, teardown of global listeners, reuse toolbar helpers)
nodes.norm_label: component quality rules (open/close/toggle api, teardown of global listeners, reuse toolbar helpers)

nodes.label: Rule: prefer resource HTML templates over reusing jsaction/jscontroller without full wiring
nodes.norm_label: rule: prefer resource html templates over reusing jsaction/jscontroller without full wiring

nodes.label: Trusted Types: DomUtils.setHTML instead of innerHTML
nodes.norm_label: trusted types: domutils.sethtml instead of innerhtml

nodes.label: 4-layer architecture (Popup / Background / Content script / Injected MAIN)
nodes.norm_label: 4-layer architecture (popup / background / content script / injected main)
nodes.rationale: Changes must not break the popup -> background -> content script -> injected flow; skipping background is an anti-pattern.

nodes.label: Pattern for new options (DEFAULT_SETTINGS_OPTIONS -> index.html -> settings.js -> applySettings -> notifyEditors)
nodes.norm_label: pattern for new options (default_settings_options -> index.html -> settings.js -> applysettings -> notifyeditors)

nodes.label: Persistence split: IndexedDB (settings/snippets/themes) + chrome.storage.sync (active theme, global toggle, LLM keys)
nodes.norm_label: persistence split: indexeddb (settings/snippets/themes) + chrome.storage.sync (active theme, global toggle, llm keys)
nodes.rationale: Large catalogs go to IndexedDB; small cross-device values to chrome.storage.sync.

nodes.label: chrome.runtime message contract (GET_SETTINGS, NOTIFY_UPDATE, LLM_REQUEST, ...)
nodes.rationale: Must not be changed without updating all layers.

nodes.label: Settings propagation flow (notifyEditors -> SETTINGS_UPDATED -> GAS_SettingsUpdated -> applySettings)
nodes.norm_label: settings propagation flow (notifyeditors -> settings_updated -> gas_settingsupdated -> applysettings)
nodes.rationale: Apply changes live without reloading the editor.

nodes.label: Active c-wiz filter (c-wiz[data-p][aria-busy=false])
nodes.rationale: Never modify nodes of the inactive GAS c-wiz.

nodes.label: providersRegistered static flag (avoid duplicate Monaco providers)
nodes.norm_label: providersregistered static flag (avoid duplicate monaco providers)

nodes.norm_label: no-server privacy model (browser talks directly to providers, github, apps script api)

nodes.label: Supported LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Kimi, Nvidia, ChatLLM, OpenRouter, Custom)
nodes.norm_label: supported llm providers (openai, anthropic, gemini, kimi, nvidia, chatllm, openrouter, custom)

nodes.label: Local model setup (LM Studio / Ollama, OpenAI-compatible endpoint)
nodes.norm_label: local model setup (lm studio / ollama, openai-compatible endpoint)
nodes.rationale: No paid API needed; nothing leaves the machine. Recommended qwen2.5-coder-3b-instruct for speed on regular laptops.

nodes.label: Copilot rule: graphify query first
nodes.rationale: Scoped subgraph from graphify query/path/explain is smaller than full report or raw grep; read source only when modifying, graph lacks detail, or graph is stale.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md graphify rules
nodes.rationale: Query graph before grep/read; run graphify update after code changes; large graph.json diffs are expected and must not be flagged as churn.
